componentTypes.label: Requirement
componentTypes.description: Reusable functional, technical, implementation, support, accessibility, security, or operational requirement.

componentTypes.label: Minimum Mandatory Requirement
componentTypes.description: Pass/fail qualification or compliance item that may determine whether a proposal proceeds.

componentTypes.label: Proposal Instruction
componentTypes.description: Instruction telling vendors what to submit and how to structure responses.

componentTypes.label: Evaluation Criterion
componentTypes.description: Criterion used to assess proposal quality, fit, risk, or value.

componentTypes.label: Scoring Weight
componentTypes.description: Weighted evaluation allocation for a phase, section, criterion, demonstration, or cost component.

componentTypes.label: Demonstration Requirement
componentTypes.description: Scenario, script, or capability vendors must demonstrate during evaluation.

componentTypes.label: Cost Requirement
componentTypes.description: Pricing table, total cost of ownership item, cost assumption, or pricing response instruction.

componentTypes.label: Contract Clause
componentTypes.description: Reusable legal or contractual obligation that should be reviewed separately from functional requirements.

componentTypes.label: SOW Task
componentTypes.description: Statement-of-work activity, service, phase, or implementation responsibility.

componentTypes.label: Deliverable
componentTypes.description: Work product, artifact, plan, report, configuration, or milestone acceptance item.

componentTypes.label: Service Level
componentTypes.description: Operational commitment, response target, resolution target, uptime target, service credit, or support coverage term.

sampleComponents.title: Phased Evaluation Model
sampleComponents.text: Represent business proposal, cost proposal, and demonstration scoring as separate weighted evaluation phases.
sampleComponents.rationale: The DA package shows that scoring and demonstrations should be modeled separately from reusable requirements.
sampleComponents.evaluationUse: Use to define future evaluation phase and scoring weight data structures.
